title: Alias Ranking, Regions, and Heatmaps
negative_results: collapsing a region to a point without a justification is refused as invented precision
an empty alias set yields no heatmap (nothing to map)

claims.statement: Aliases are ranked only by predeclared rules (score, then description length in bits = log2(search_space_count), then codec id); region area scales with uncertainty and each region carries an area plus a search-space count (POWER).

Where a unique point is unavailable the ambiguity is expressed as a region or heatmap, never invented precision; a region is not collapsed to a point without an explicit justification, and ranking never consults a known destination.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs or personal data
